**I cannot compute the embedded emissions for this shipment.**

The ruleset requires a default SEE value selected jointly by good CN code and country of production. Your request fails the first input check:

| Required input | Status | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | **Missing** | CN 7208 (hot-rolled flat steel) is not in the factor table. |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | **Missing** | China is listed for other CN codes, but not for 7208, so no China SEE applies to this good. |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | Provided | 5,000 t |

The table contains China values for CN 7201, 7206 10 00, 7207 11 90, and 7214 20 00. None of these is the declared good, so I have not used any of them as a substitute.

To compute the figure, the factor table needs a default SEE entry for **CN 7208 with China as the country of production**. Once that value is supplied, the calculation is: embedded emissions (tCO2e) = SEE (tCO2e/t) × 5,000 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
